candidates.change_summary: Change paused() to return the negation of the internal _paused flag so callers observe inverted paused state.
Changed the access check to require the caller to be a MANAGER rather than the DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, altering who can call updateLRTConfig and thus change lrtConfig.
Removed the non-zero address check so updateLRTConfig allows setting lrtConfig to the zero address, changing post-call state when called with zero.
Emit the previous lrtConfig address in the event instead of the new address, changing observed event data after update.
Invert the role check so only callers without DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE can call functions guarded by onlyLRTAdmin, changing who may call updateLRTConfig.
Initialize sets maxNodeDelegatorCount to 0 instead of 10.
Initialize assigns maxNodeDelegatorCount from the provided lrtConfig address (casts address to uint256), changing stored value based on parameter.

initializer modifier sets _initialized = 2 instead of 1, allowing initialize to considered already at version 2 so initializer reentrancy logic changes effect on initialization ordering (affects whether initialize body runs under same conditions), which can alter whether maxNodeDelegatorCount assignment in initialize executes in some call sequences.
